title: Collapse Preservation under Subdivision
statement: If a simplicial complex $C$ collapses to a subcomplex $C'$, and $D$ is a subdivision of $C$ restricting to a subdivision $D'$ of $C'$, must $D$ collapse to $D'$?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Triangulations (2013), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2012/24, pp. 1405--1486](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2012/24)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** partially solved

**Assessment.** The subdivision question is open in its stated form, but a barycentric subdivision of D is proved to collapse to the corresponding barycentric subdivision of D-prime, with further low-dimensional positive cases.

**Sources checked.**

- [Adiprasito--Benedetti](https://arxiv.org/abs/1709.07930)
- [original OWR report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2012/24)
